summary: This video vlog follows a Chinese student sharing daily moments from her school life, including going to classes, eating meals, and hanging out with friends. She chats warmly with her viewers about her busy week and school routines.

phrases.usage: A cheerful, friendly greeting to use when speaking to a group of friends or family.
phrases.example_pron: dà jiā hǎo ya, wǒ shì xiǎo míng.

phrases.usage: Say this to your friends or teacher when school ends for the day.
A warm and cute way to greet someone when you wake up in the morning.
phrases.example_pron: mā ma, zǎo shang hǎo ya!

phrases.quote: 开心开心开心可以吃饭了
phrases.usage: Use this word whenever you feel joyful or satisfied about something.
phrases.example_pron: jīn tiān wǒ hěn kāi xīn.

phrases.usage: Shout this happily when classes finish at the end of the school day.
phrases.example_pron: fàng xué la, wǒ men huí jiā ba!
phrases.example_en: School is out, let's go home!

phrases.usage: Use this phrase on a sunny or pleasant day outside.
phrases.example_pron: jīn tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo.
phrases.example_en: The weather is very nice today.

phrases.usage: Say this when you taste something really yummy like ice cream or dumplings.
phrases.example_pron: zhè ge píng guǒ fēi cháng hǎo chī!

phrases.usage: Say this when you feel tired and ready to go to sleep.
phrases.example_pron: wǒ hǎo kùn, xiǎng shuì jiào.
phrases.example_en: I am so sleepy, I want to sleep.

phrases.usage: Use this term when talking about your physical education class at school.
phrases.example_pron: jīn tiān wǒ men yǒu tǐ yù kè.
